items.question: What happens if the round robin quantum is too large?
Why can shortest job first starve long jobs?
items.correct_answer: Short jobs keep being chosen first, so a long job may never run.

items.question: Why is the next CPU burst a problem for shortest job first?
items.correct_answer: The system does not know the burst length in advance.

items.question: What is the convoy effect?
items.correct_answer: A long job at the front makes everything behind it wait.
